snippet.title: Alruna: End of History. TRAILER 1 (Announcement Trailer)
snippet.description:
Alruna; now in wide-screen! A different kind of Metroidvania, a tour-de-force of game design, with world-class temples and dungeons. Dead men yearn for Heaven, but Elysium remains out of their grasp.

WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3440260/Alruna_End_of_History/


Alruna: End of History is Published by BURNING PLANET DIGITAL:
https://www.burningplanet.se
